messages:
Sam (Partnerships): Quick kickoff — interoperability sprint for staging. We need a lightweight runbook to validate LangChain and LlamaIndex adapters across GatewayX and FlowBridge staging, and to exercise orchestration fallbacks. Goals: smoke tests, demo matrix, co-demo creds, and a brief co-ann blackout window. TL;DR: who owns which bits?
Nina (Eng-Platform): I can own the staging infra + test harness. Will stand up ephemeral namespaces and a small kafka queue for eventing.
Rory (DevEx): I'll draft the adapter compatibility checklist. Items: schema mapping, chunking behavior, metadata passthrough, and rate-limit semantics.
Kai (Product): Need to confirm partner marketing asks — do we want a joint demo or just partner-hosted recordings? Also what's the timeline for the announcement?
Sam (Partnerships): Target demo for partner summit on 2026-06-10. Prefer joint live demo if partners OK. Announce window: blackout 48h before live. Partners will run final smoke the day before.
Rory (DevEx): Proposed smoke test script snippet:
```bash
# minimal runner to validate adapter roundtrip
curl -s -X POST https://staging.gatewayx.redwood/api/run -d '{"flow":"ll-index","prompt":"hello"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEMO_KEY'
```
Expect 200 + token-stream start within 300ms.
Nina (Eng-Platform): Ops: assign demo creds per partner, ephemeral keys expire in 36h. I'll add a script to rotate keys automatically. Also creating a /staging/interop health endpoint returning: `ok, adapters:[langchain,llamaindex], gates:[gatewayx,flowbridge]`.
Sam (Partnerships): Partners to provide adapter builds by 2026-05-20. We'll do two pass validations: partner-run smoke (they run locally) + infra-run smoke (we run against staging).
Kai (Product): For co-marketing, we need a short one-pager and a joint FAQ. Sam, can you coordinate assets?
Sam (Partnerships): Yep. I'll collect logos, approved quotes, and demo scripts. Need partner legal OK on 2026-05-25.
Rory (DevEx): On the checklist, add: quantization parity (fp16 vs int8) and embedding shape/length tests for LlamaIndex index reload. Small test cases included.
Nina (Eng-Platform): OpsBot ping: creating namespaces now.
OpsBot: [system] namespace interop-staging-2026-05 created (ttl: 72h).
Rory (DevEx): Diffs vs previous integration runs: we should record latency tails under load (95th/99th) and KV-cache correctness. I'll add a simple locust scenario.
Sam (Partnerships): Risk notes: hardware variants may cause tokenization differences -> ask partners to include tokenizer version. Also ensure telemetry covers token-level failures.
Kai (Product): Timeline recap?
Sam (Partnerships): Milestones: adapters ETA 2026-05-20; partner legal signoff 2026-05-25; infra run 2026-05-26 to 2026-05-29; dry-run demo 2026-06-08; live 2026-06-10.
Rory (DevEx): I'll create a lightweight GitHub repo with the smoke tests + sample adapter shim. Link when ready.
Nina (Eng-Platform): Allocated a 2-GPU staging cluster per partner for load tests. Ops team will monitor.
Sam (Partnerships): Ok team — next check-in Wednesday 14:00 PT. Action items: Nina infra, Rory checklist + test repo, Kai marketing one-pager, partners: adapter builds + tokenizer info. :rocket:
Kai (Product): Noted. Adding partner comms draft to the shared doc.
Sam (Partnerships): Thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker ping me or drop into #eng-platform.
